page.notes: The page number is printed as "189" with a worn 9. The running head "EXPEL." is partly worn, so the final letters are doubtful. The marginal note is set in small italic type and runs over four short lines; it is read as "Tridentinæ reformationi effectus in ipsius regni", with hyphens at the line breaks. The long s is rendered as a plain s throughout. Double full stops after "implicantur" and "allegant" and "constat" are as printed.
